content.rendered: If you were unable to purchase a school supply box or prefer to shop for your own supplies you can refer to this Supply List (Spanish version) to aide in your shopping. At this time we are planning to have our Annual Supply Night on Thursday, September 2nd, 4:00 pm – 6:00 pm. At that time you can bring your supplies in and deliver them to your classroom. If you ordered a Supply Box it will be here waiting for you in your classroom.
